description: This is a test source file for the GatewayEnvironment component in a Swift project, containing unit tests for version parsing, normalization, compatibility, port defaults, and version extraction.

methods.name: semver parses common forms

methods.name: semver compatibility requires same major and not older
methods.description: Validates semantic version compatibility rules requiring same major version and newer or equal minor and patch versions.
